web.about.body1: The page stores neither inputs nor results: no cookies, no browser storage, nothing in the address bar. Only language, mode and cell-reading preferences are remembered in your browser.

web.about.body3: The site is hosted on Azure Static Web Apps. The provider may keep ordinary server logs (IP address, URL, browser).
